title: CPC-2025-5194-HD-CU2-PR-ZC
text:
CPC-2025-5194-HD-CU2-PR-ZC  Council District: 10 – Hutt
  CEQA: ENV-2025-5195-MND  Last Day to Act: 07-26-26
  Plan Area: Wilshire

  PUBLIC HEARING – Completed May 12, 2026

  PROJECT SITE:  4802 – 4828 West San Vicente Boulevard

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Demolition and removal of the existing one-story warehouse building and two surface parking lots for the
  construction, use, and maintenance of a seven-story self-storage facility for household goods encompassing
  a floor area of 161,645 square feet. The self-storage facility would feature storage units across each floor
  level, a 954-square-foot office area, a 608-square-foot lobby, a 376-square-foot community room/multi-
  purpose room, five vehicular parking spaces, 36 bicycle parking spaces, and two loading spaces and would
  operate between 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m., daily.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15074(b), consideration of the whole of the administrative record,
  including the Mitigated Negative Declaration, No. ENV-2025-5195-MND (“Mitigated Negative
  Declaration”), all comments received, the imposition of mitigation measures and the Mitigation Monitoring
  Program prepared for the Mitigated Negative Declaration;
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1A Section 13B.1.4 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC), a Vesting Zone
  Change and Height District Change from the C2-1-O Zone to (Q)(T)C2-2D-O Zone in order to permit
  additional floor area up to a maximum Floor Area Ratio of 6:1 in lieu of 1.5:1; including the following:
  a. A waiver of the requirement to dedicate and/or improve an additional 2.5 feet of the existing public
  alley
  3. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.2, a Class 2 Conditional Use Permit to permit storage uses
  with 500 feet of a R Zone; and
  4. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.4, a Project Review for a proposed development project that
  results in an increase of 50,000 gross square feet of non-residential floor area.

  Applicant:  David Kelly, Westport Properties Inc.
  Representative: Dana Sayles, three6ixty

  Staff:  David Woon, Planning Assistant
  david.woon@lacity.org
  (213) 978-1368
summary: Demolition of a warehouse building and construction of a seven-story self-storage facility at 4802 West San Vicente Boulevard with office, lobby, and community room spaces.
